governing_freeze.rule: This file only expands immutable references already fixed by the governing protocol. It does not alter, relax, tune, or replace that protocol.

targets.definition: For horizon h, sqrt(sum(one-trade price_change^2)) over strictly later economic fills through t+h; NULL when no later economic fill occurs in (t,t+h].
targets.observed_stasis: Zero is retained only when a later economic fill exists and the realised movement is zero.

feature_definitions.realised_vol_5: sqrt(sum(one-trade price_change^2)) over the backward/current 5-second window.
feature_definitions.absolute_return_5: Absolute backward-window price change over 5 seconds.
feature_definitions.absolute_return_15: Absolute backward-window price change over 15 seconds.
feature_definitions.absolute_return_30: Absolute backward-window price change over 30 seconds.
feature_definitions.absolute_return_60: Absolute backward-window price change over 60 seconds.
feature_definitions.absolute_return_120: Absolute backward-window price change over 120 seconds.
feature_definitions.absolute_return_300: Absolute backward-window price change over 300 seconds.
feature_definitions.absolute_return_900: Absolute backward-window price change over 900 seconds.
feature_definitions.recent_max_move_900: Maximum absolute one-trade price change in the backward/current 900-second window.
feature_definitions.distance_recent_low_300: Current p_yes minus rolling 300-second minimum p_yes.

fit_recipe.historical_training_population: Corrected-order 005B TRAIN+DEV decisions only: timestamp < dev_end_timestamp-300, target non-null, label endpoint non-null and label endpoint < dev_end_timestamp.
fit_recipe.sampling: Per family ORDER BY hash(condition_id, tx_hash, log_index) LIMIT 100000; concatenate five families; no target-value sampling.

external_evaluation.evaluation_rows: All supported DATA-003 rows after exact feature/target support and window-boundary validity rules; no target-value sampling.

baseline_definitions.persistence: Historical TRAIN+DEV mean for positive realised-movement targets.

external_evaluation.uncertainty: Hierarchical family/market bootstrap on market-level candidate-minus-persistence MAE differences.

success_failure.per_horizon_success: Candidate MAE must beat every frozen named baseline and hierarchical bootstrap lower_2_5 must be > 0.
success_failure.package_success: All seven frozen horizons must satisfy the per-horizon success rule.
success_failure.failure: Any horizon failing its frozen rule is reported as failure/partial transfer; no replacement horizon, feature, model, threshold, mapping slice, or candidate may be introduced.

multiple_testing.treatment: No reselection or multiplicity-driven rescue. Package-level success is the preregistered conjunction that all seven fixed horizons pass their frozen rule.

exclusions: No event-time target is eligible for R1 transfer.
No mapping-class subset may become the primary test or rescue a failure.
No row may cross a DATA-003 capture window boundary for a feature lookback or target label endpoint.
If an original selected feature cannot be materialized faithfully, that target is INAPPLICABLE; no substitute feature or simplified model is allowed.
No new target, feature, model class, hyperparameter, threshold, horizon, sampling rule, baseline, metric, or success criterion may be introduced.
